date.as_written: śrīśāke 1818 śrīsamvat 1951 śrīnepāliyasaṃvat 1015 sāla miti pauṣa śukla 8 roja

notes: The date specifies three eras: ŚS 1818, VS 1951, and NS 1015. VS 1951 and NS 1015 correspond to 1894–1895 CE (Pauṣa śukla 8 = January 1895 CE), whereas ŚS 1818 appears to be discrepant (ŚS 1816 would correspond to VS 1951). Śākyasiṃha (the Buddha) is mentioned only as the speaker/subject of the text.
